articles.title: Council Votes on Community Oven After Long Debate
articles.deck: Residents of Marsh Landing filled the hall on Wednesday to ask questions about the plan.
body: The plan calls for community oven along Dayton Road, with work expected to start in April.

body: Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Lorraine Garrity spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Lorraine Garrity died in April at home on Juniper Drive, at the age of 88.

articles.title: Letters: Fairview Road Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Fairview Road use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the January meeting.
To the editor: I have lived on Fairview Road for 37 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Dana Kim, Cedar Hollow
